summary: Advises turning complex playbooks into roles, which separate defaults, handlers, vars and tasks into directories, are easier to maintain, and can be shared on Galaxy.
questions: When should I convert a playbook into a role?
What are the benefits of roles over one big playbook?

answer_card.title: When to turn a playbook into a role
answer_card.answer_md: Past a certain complexity, roles beat all-in-one playbooks: defaults, handlers, variables and tasks live in separate directories, they're easier to read and maintain, and they're easy to share on **Ansible Galaxy**.
